_comment: Scoring constants. CONFIRM THESE AGAINST fantasysurvivorgame.com/rules.html.
The site is unreachable from the machine that built this repo (egress policy),
so the vote block is reconstructed from the site's indexed rules text and the
draft block is a documented GUESS patterned on the common format.
Every number here is read from this file at run time - correct a value and
every recommendation updates. Nothing is hard-coded in the source.
confidence: high = quoted from the site's own rules text, low = assumed.

vote.points_awarded: points you assigned to the castaway voted out
vote.deadline: before the episode airs on the US East coast
